name: Seerr
longDescription:
Seerr is a free and open source software application for managing requests for your media library. It is the unified successor to Overseerr and Jellyseerr.

Seerr integrates with the media server of your choice: Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby. In addition, it integrates with your existing services, such as Sonarr and Radarr.

Seerr helps you find media you want to watch. With inline recommendations and suggestions, you will find yourself deeper and deeper in a rabbit hole of content you never knew you just had to have.

It presents you and your users with a request interface that is incredibly easy to understand and use. Users can select the exact seasons they want to watch. Advanced users can use the "Advanced Requests" options to change destination folders and quality profiles.

Seerr also supports PostgreSQL and SQLite databases, granular permission systems, watchlisting, and more.
description: Seerr is a request management and media discovery tool that works with Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. The unified successor to Overseerr and Jellyseerr.
